Leah/Adam —

Quick update/outcome:
- Root cause: token refreshes to our auth service were delayed due to a config propagation error during the 06:58 deploy.
- Impact: auth timeouts caused ~4% request failure against the model endpoint; amplified by a batch of concurrent requests from POS gateways.
- Mitigation performed: rollback completed, token propagation fixed, traffic shifted to backup region for 30 minutes.
- Next steps: we'll send a short postmortem by EOD with timeline and a proposed change to prevent propagation races (feature flag gating + preflight checks).

We realize the no‑show made this worse — we've opened an internal RCA and will share our oncall rotation improvement plan. Marissa will coordinate a customer follow-up and credits discussion if warranted.

Thanks for your patience. I'll schedule a 30‑minute follow‑up call tomorrow to walk the PM/infra teams through the timeline.

Rishi
Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
